name: add_comment
description:
Adds a comment or note to an existing Todoist task.

Args:
    task_id: ID of the task to attach the comment to.
    content: Comment text or markdown notes (max 4096 chars).

task_id.description: The Todoist Task ID to attach the comment to (required).
task_id.title: Task Id

content.description: The text content or markdown note of the comment (required).
content.title: Content

name: complete_task
description:
Marks an existing Todoist task as completed.

Args:
    task_id: The ID of the Todoist task to mark as completed (max 100 chars).

task_id.description: The Todoist Task ID to complete (required).
task_id.title: Task Id

name: create_label
description:
Creates a new label in Todoist.

Args:
    name: Name of the label (must not be empty, max 60 chars).
    color: Optional color name (e.g. 'berry_red', 'sky_blue', 'mint_green').

name.description: The name of the new label (required, e.g. 'work', 'focus').
name.title: Name

color.description: Color name for the label icon (e.g. 'berry_red', 'mint_green', 'teal', optional).
color.title: Color

name: create_project
description:
Creates a new project or subproject in Todoist.

Args:
    name: Name of the project (must not be empty, max 120 chars).
    parent_project_name_or_id: Optional parent project name or ID to create as a nested subproject.
    color: Optional color name (e.g. 'berry_red', 'sky_blue', 'mint_green').

name.description: The name of the new project (required).
name.title: Name

parent_project_name_or_id.description: Parent project name or ID to create this project as a nested subproject (optional).
parent_project_name_or_id.title: Parent Project Name Or Id

color.description: Color name for the project icon (e.g. 'berry_red', 'charcoal', 'teal', optional).
color.title: Color

name: create_section
description:
Creates a new section (column / Kanban list) in a Todoist project.

Args:
    name: Name of the section (must not be empty, max 120 chars).
    project_name_or_id: Target project name or ID.

name.description: The name of the new section/column (required, e.g. 'In Progress', 'Done').
name.title: Name

project_name_or_id.description: The name or ID of the parent project where the section will be created (required).
project_name_or_id.title: Project Name Or Id

name: create_task
description:
Creates a new task in Todoist with smart project, section, label, and due date resolution.

Args:
    content: Task title/content (must not be empty, max 500 chars).
    description: Task notes or description (max 4096 chars).
    project_name: Target project name (max 120 chars, defaults to 'Gelen Kutusu').
    due_string: Natural language date string (e.g. 'tomorrow at 14:00', max 150 chars).
    priority: Priority integer strictly between 1 (normal) and 4 (urgent).
    labels: Optional list of label strings to attach to the task.
    section_name_or_id: Optional target section name or ID within the project.
    parent_id: Optional Todoist task ID to create this task as a subtask of (max 100 chars).
    deadline_date: Optional official deadline date (YYYY-MM-DD), distinct from due_string.

content.description: The text content/title of the task (required).
content.title: Content

description.description: Detailed description or notes for the task (optional).
description.title: Description

project_name.description: Target Todoist project name (defaults to 'Gelen Kutusu' / Inbox).
project_name.title: Project Name

due_string.description: Natural language due date/time or recurring schedule (e.g. 'tomorrow at 14:00', 'every Monday').
due_string.title: Due String

labels.description: List of label names to attach to the task (e.g. ['work', 'urgent'], optional).
labels.title: Labels

section_name_or_id.description: Target section name or ID within the project (optional).
section_name_or_id.title: Section Name Or Id

parent_id.description: Bu görevi belirtilen Todoist görev ID'sinin alt görevi (subtask) yapar (opsiyonel).
parent_id.title: Parent Id

deadline_date.description: Optional official deadline date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-09-01'). This is independent from due_string: due_string controls when the task is scheduled to be worked on, while deadline_date sets Todoist's separate 'Deadline' — a hard due-by date shown distinctly in the UI (optional).
deadline_date.title: Deadline Date

name: delete_label
description:
Deletes a label from Todoist by either its ID or label name.

Args:
    label_name_or_id: The ID or name of the label to delete.

label_name_or_id.description: The Todoist Label ID or Name to delete (required).
label_name_or_id.title: Label Name Or Id

name: delete_project
description:
Deletes a project from Todoist by either its ID or project name.

Args:
    project_name_or_id: The ID or name of the project to delete.

project_name_or_id.description: The Todoist Project ID or Project Name to delete (required).
project_name_or_id.title: Project Name Or Id

name: delete_section
description:
Deletes a section from Todoist by its ID or name.

Args:
    section_name_or_id: The ID or name of the section to delete.

section_name_or_id.description: The Todoist Section ID or Name to delete (required).
section_name_or_id.title: Section Name Or Id

name: delete_task
description:
Permanently deletes a task from Todoist by ID.

Args:
    task_id: The ID of the Todoist task to delete permanently.

task_id.description: The Todoist Task ID to delete permanently (required).
task_id.title: Task Id

name: get_comments
description:
Retrieves all comments and notes attached to a specific Todoist task.

Args:
    task_id: The ID of the task whose comments will be retrieved.

task_id.description: The Todoist Task ID to retrieve comments for (required).
task_id.title: Task Id

name: get_project
description:
Retrieves a single Todoist project by its ID, showing all its fields (name, color, parent_id, favorite status, view style).

Args:
    project_id: The ID of the Todoist project to retrieve (max 100 chars).

project_id.description: The Todoist Project ID to retrieve (required).
project_id.title: Project Id

name: get_task
description:
Retrieves a single Todoist task by its ID, showing all its fields (parent_id, due date, labels, description, priority, project/section IDs, etc.).

Args:
    task_id: The ID of the Todoist task to retrieve (max 100 chars).

task_id.description: The Todoist Task ID to retrieve (required).
task_id.title: Task Id

name: list_labels
description: Lists all user labels in Todoist with their names, IDs, and color information.

name: list_projects
description: Lists all user projects in Todoist with their hierarchy (nested/subprojects), names, IDs, and details.

name: list_sections
description: Lists sections (Kanban columns) in Todoist for a specific project or across all projects.

project_name_or_id.description: Optional project name or ID to list sections specifically for that project.
project_name_or_id.title: Project Name Or Id

name: list_tasks
description:
Lists open tasks in Todoist matching the specified filter query.

Args:
    filter_query: Todoist filter query (e.g. 'today', 'p1', 'overdue', '@work', max 500 chars).

name: reopen_task
description:
Reopens an existing completed Todoist task (makes it active again).

Args:
    task_id: The ID of the completed Todoist task to reopen.

task_id.description: The Todoist Task ID to reopen/uncomplete (required).
task_id.title: Task Id

name: update_label
description:
Updates an existing Todoist label's name or color.

Args:
    label_name_or_id: Name or ID of the label to update (required).
    new_name: New name for the label.
    color: New color name for the label.

label_name_or_id.description: The Todoist Label ID or Name to update (required).
label_name_or_id.title: Label Name Or Id

color.description: New color name for the label (e.g. 'berry_red', 'teal', optional).
color.title: Color

name: update_project
description:
Updates an existing Todoist project's name or color.

Note: Todoist's API does not support changing a project's parent through this
endpoint (there is no move/reparent operation for projects), so this tool only
updates name and color.

Args:
    project_name_or_id: The ID or name of the project to update (required).
    name: New name for the project (max 120 chars).
    color: New color name for the project icon (e.g. 'berry_red', 'sky_blue', 'mint_green').

project_name_or_id.description: The Todoist Project ID or Project Name to update (required).
project_name_or_id.title: Project Name Or Id

color.description: New color name for the project icon (e.g. 'berry_red', 'charcoal', 'teal', optional).
color.title: Color

name: update_section
description:
Renames an existing section (column / Kanban list) in Todoist.

Args:
    section_name_or_id: ID or current name of the section to rename.
    name: New section name (must not be empty, max 120 chars).
    project_name_or_id: Optional project scope used to resolve the section by name.

section_name_or_id.description: The Todoist Section ID or current Section Name to rename (required).
section_name_or_id.title: Section Name Or Id

name.description: The new name for the section (required).
name.title: Name

project_name_or_id.description: Optional project name or ID to disambiguate when several projects have a section with the same name.
project_name_or_id.title: Project Name Or Id

name: update_task
description:
Updates an existing Todoist task's title, description, due date, deadline, priority, labels, or moves it to another project/section/parent.

Args:
    task_id: The ID of the Todoist task to update (required).
    content: New title/content for the task.
    description: New description or notes for the task.
    project_name: Name of target project to move task into.
    due_string: New natural language due date or schedule.
    priority: Priority integer between 1 (Normal) and 4 (Urgent).
    labels: New list of label names for the task.
    section_name_or_id: Target section name or ID to move task into.
    parent_id: New parent task ID (subtask), or "" to promote the task back to the top level.
    deadline_date: New official deadline date (YYYY-MM-DD), distinct from due_string.

task_id.description: The Todoist Task ID to update (required).
task_id.title: Task Id

description.description: New description or notes for the task (optional).
description.title: Description

project_name.description: Target project name to move the task into (optional).
project_name.title: Project Name

due_string.description: New natural language due date/time (e.g. 'tomorrow at 15:00', 'no date', optional).
due_string.title: Due String

labels.description: New list of label names for the task (replaces existing labels, optional).
labels.title: Labels

section_name_or_id.description: Target section name or ID to move the task into (optional).
section_name_or_id.title: Section Name Or Id

parent_id.description: New parent Todoist task ID to make this task a subtask of. Pass an empty string ("") to remove the current parent and move the task back to the top level (optional). Omit entirely to leave the parent unchanged.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

deadline_date.description: New official deadline date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-09-01'). This is independent from due_string: due_string controls when the task is scheduled to be worked on, while deadline_date sets Todoist's separate 'Deadline' — a hard due-by date shown distinctly in the UI (optional).
deadline_date.title: Deadline Date
